55059-modern-english-biography-volume-1-.creator: Frederic Boase.
55059-modern-english-biography-volume-1-.description: A book by Frederic Boase.. General Biography has now become so large a subject, that no one work can comprehend it, and it will, it is imagined, in future, be necessary to attack it in small sections, if anything like justice is to be done to the matter.

arxiv-2107-02314.creator: Ujjwal Baid, Satyam Ghodasara, Suyash Mohan, Michel Bilello, Evan Calabrese, Errol Colak, Keyvan Farahani, Jayashree Kalpathy-Cramer, Felipe C. Kitamura, Sarthak Pati, Luciano M. Prevedello, Jeffrey D. Rudie, Chiharu Sako, Russell T. Shinohara, Timothy Bergquist, Rong Chai, James Eddy, Julia Elliott
arxiv-2107-02314.description: Abstract The BraTS 2021 challenge celebrates its 10 t ​ h 10^{th} anniversary and is jointly organized by the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), and the Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Interventions (MICCAI) society.

arxiv-2110-15332.title: Proximal Reinforcement Learning: Efficient Off-Policy Evaluation in Partially Observed Markov Decision Processes
arxiv-2110-15332.creator: Andrew Bennett, Nathan Kallus
arxiv-2110-15332.description: Abstract In applications of offline reinforcement learning to observational data, such as in healthcare or education, a general concern is that observed actions might be affected by unobserved factors, inducing confounding and biasing estimates derived under the assumption of a perfect Markov decision process (MDP) model. Here we tackle this by considering off-policy evaluation in an partially observed MDP (POMDP).

arxiv-2203-15656.title: Understanding the magnetic response of the Quantum Spin Liquid compound 1 T T -TaS 2
arxiv-2203-15656.creator: Sudip Pal, S. B. Roy
arxiv-2203-15656.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sudip Pal, S. B. Roy. 1 T T -tantalum disulphide (1 T T -TaS 2 ) is a promising material to realize quantum spin liquid state and fractional excitations. Here, we take a closer look on the temperature dependent magnetic susceptibility of 1 T T -TaS 2 at low magnetic fields to understand the formation of local magnetic moment in this system and its response as a function of temperature and field.

arxiv-2204-02853.title: Systematic investigation of critical charge limits in Thick GEMs Journal: NIM A
arxiv-2204-02853.creator: P. Gasik, L. Lautner, L. Fabbietti, H. Fribert, T. Klemenz, A. Mathis, B. Ulukutlu, T. Waldmann
arxiv-2204-02853.description: Abstract We present discharge probability studies performed with a single Thick Gas Electron Multiplier (THGEM) irradiated with alpha particles in Ar-CO 2 and Ne-CO 2 mixtures. We observe a clear dependency of the discharge stability on the noble gas and quencher content pointing to lighter gases being more stable against the development of streamer discharges.

arxiv-2209-05981.title: Fractional Charges in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Model
arxiv-2209-05981.creator: Yi-Dong Wu
arxiv-2209-05981.description: Abstract The Su-Schrieffer-Heeger(SSH) model has been widely used to study the topological property of 1D systems. It is claimed that there is fractional charge at the boundary of the nontrivial phase while none at that of trivial phase. However, this conclusion is in direct contradiction to the modern theory of polarization(MTP).

arxiv-2210-11506.title: Compton-thick AGN in the NuSTAR Era. IX. A Joint NuSTAR and XMM-Newton Analysis of Four Local AGN
arxiv-2210-11506.creator: R. Silver, N. Torres-Albà, X. Zhao, S. Marchesi, A. Pizzetti, I. Cox, M. Ajello, G. Cusumano, V. La Parola, A. Segreto
arxiv-2210-11506.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by R. Silver, N. Torres-Albà, X. Zhao, S. Marchesi, A. Pizzetti, I. Cox, M. Ajello, G. Cusumano, V. La Parola, A. Segreto. We present the results of the broadband X-ray spectral analysis of simultaneous NuSTAR and XMM- Newton observations of four nearby Compton-thick active galactic nuclei (AGN) candidates selected from the Swift -Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) 150-month catalog.

arxiv-2212-12080.description: Abstract We provide a version of the Stein–Weiss inequality for arbitrary martingales. 1 Introduction The classical Hardy–Littlewood–Sobolev plays an important role in analysis. It was initially introduced in [ 4 ] as a tool to prove Sobolev’s embedding theorem. The inequality says that the Riesz potential (i.e.

arxiv-2303-11811.title: Efficiency and scalability of fully-resolved fluid-particle simulations on heterogeneous CPU-GPU architectures
arxiv-2303-11811.creator: Samuel Kemmler \affilnum 1,2, Christoph Rettinger \affilnum 1, Ulrich Rüde \affilnum 1,3, Pablo Cuéllar \affilnum 2 and Harald Köstler \affilnum 1
arxiv-2303-11811.description: Abstract Current supercomputers often have a heterogeneous architecture using both CPUs and GPUs. At the same time, numerical simulation tasks frequently involve multiphysics scenarios whose components run on different hardware due to multiple reasons, e.g., architectural requirements, pragmatism, etc. This leads naturally to a software design where different simulation modules are mapped to different subsystems of the heterogeneous architecture.

arxiv-2305-10443.title: SuperDriverAI: Towards Design and Implementation for End-to-End Learning-based Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2305-10443.creator: Shunsuke Aoki, Issei Yamamoto, Daiki Shiotsuka, Yuichi Inoue, Kento Tokuhiro, Keita Miwa
arxiv-2305-10443.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shunsuke Aoki, Issei Yamamoto, Daiki Shiotsuka, Yuichi Inoue, Kento Tokuhiro, Keita Miwa. Fully autonomous driving has been widely studied and is becoming increasingly feasible. However, such autonomous driving has yet to be achieved on public roads, because of various uncertainties due to surrounding human drivers and pedestrians.

arxiv-2305-18050.title: Deciphering the physical basis of the intermediate-scale instability
arxiv-2305-18050.creator: Mohamad Shalaby \corresp, Timon Thomas, Christoph Pfrommer, Rouven Lemmerz, and Virginia Bresci
arxiv-2305-18050.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mohamad Shalaby \corresp, Timon Thomas, Christoph Pfrommer, Rouven Lemmerz, and Virginia Bresci. We study the underlying physics of cosmic-ray (CR) driven instabilities that play a crucial role for CR transport across a wide range of scales, from interstellar to galaxy cluster environments. By examining the linear dispersion relation of CR-driven instabilities in a magnetised electron-ion background plasma, we establish that both, the intermediate and gyroscale instabilities have a resonant origin and show that these resonances can be understood via a simple graphical interpretation.

arxiv-2306-00100.title: MetaXLR - Mixed Language Meta Representation Transformation for Low-resource Cross-lingual Learning based on Multi-Armed Bandit
arxiv-2306-00100.creator: Liat Bezalel, Eyal Orgad
arxiv-2306-00100.description: Abstract Transfer learning for extremely low-resource languages is a challenging task as there is no large-scale monolingual corpora for pre-training or sufficient annotated data for fine-tuning. We follow the work of Xia et al. 2021 which suggests using meta learning for transfer learning from a single source language to an extremely low resource one.

arxiv-2310-07863.title: A rotating accretion disk around MWC 297, a young B1.5 Ve star
arxiv-2310-07863.creator: Göran Sandell, William Vacca
arxiv-2310-07863.description: Abstract High resolution spectra with iSHELL on IRTF in the K and M band of the young, heavily accreting B 1.5e star MWC 297 show numerous double-peaked CO lines. These CO lines originate in an inclined gaseous disk in Keplerian rotation. MWC 297 is the only early B star known to show a Keplerian disk in CO.

arxiv-2312-13240.title: Efficient Verification-Based Face Identification
arxiv-2312-13240.creator: Amit Rozner Barak Battash Ofir Lindenbaum and Lior Wolf Faculty of Engineering, Bar Ilan University School of Computer Science, Tel Aviv University These authors contributed equally.
arxiv-2312-13240.description: Abstract We study the problem of performing face verification with an efficient neural model f f . The efficiency of f f stems from simplifying the face verification problem from an embedding nearest neighbor search into a binary problem; each user has its own neural network f f .

arxiv-2401-05060.title: MuTox: Universal MUltilingual Audio-based TOXicity Dataset and Zero-shot Detector
arxiv-2401-05060.creator: Marta R. Costa-jussà, Mariano Coria Meglioli, Pierre Andrews
arxiv-2401-05060.description: Abstract Research in toxicity detection in natural language processing for the speech modality (audio-based) is quite limited, particularly for languages other than English. To address these limitations and lay the groundwork for truly multilingual audio-based toxicity detection, we introduce MuTox, the first highly multilingual audio-based dataset with toxicity labels which covers 14 different linguistic families.

arxiv-2403-10240.title: Spatial Dependence of the Growth Factor in Scalar-Tensor Cosmology
arxiv-2403-10240.creator: Joseph Sultana
arxiv-2403-10240.description: Abstract Scalar-tensor theories have taken on a key role in attempts to confront the growing open questions in standard cosmology. It is important to understand entirely their dynamics at perturbative level including any possible spatial dependence in their growth of large scale structures.

arxiv-2404-15143.title: Every Breath You Don’t Take: Deepfake Speech Detection Using Breath
arxiv-2404-15143.creator: Seth Layton, Thiago De Andrade, Daniel Olszewski, Kevin Warren, Kevin Butler, Patrick Traynor
arxiv-2404-15143.description: Abstract . Deepfake speech represents a real and growing threat to systems and society. Many detectors have been created to aid in defense against speech deepfakes. While these detectors implement myriad methodologies, many rely on low-level fragments of the speech generation process.

arxiv-2406-03946.title: A Probabilistic Approach to Learning the Degree of Equivariance in Steerable CNNs
arxiv-2406-03946.creator: Lars Veefkind, Gabriele Cesa
arxiv-2406-03946.description: Abstract Steerable convolutional neural networks (SCNNs) enhance task performance by modelling geometric symmetries through equivariance constraints on weights. Yet, unknown or varying symmetries can lead to overconstrained weights and decreased performance. To address this, this paper introduces a probabilistic method to learn the degree of equivariance in SCNNs.

arxiv-2406-14036.title: Towards Infinite-Long Prefix in Transformer
arxiv-2406-14036.creator: Yingyu Liang, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song, Chiwun Yang
arxiv-2406-14036.description: Abstract Prompting and context-based fine-tuning methods, which we call Prefix Learning, have been proposed to enhance the performance of language models on various downstream tasks. They are empirically efficient and effective, matching the performance of full parameter fine-tuning, but the theoretical understandings are limited.

arxiv-2410-07734.title: Optimisation Abstraite Exposé aux séminaires de laboratoire LATAO, Faculté des Sciences de Tunis, Jeudi 18-2-2021.
arxiv-2410-07734.creator: Fethi Kadhi
arxiv-2410-07734.description: Abstract Les concepts de base en théorie des catégories sont les représentables, les adjoints, les limites et les monades. Dans cet exposé, on définit la notion d’extension de Kan et on montre que cette notion couvre ces concepts. Keywords: Kan extension, Pointwise Kan extension, Représentables, Limites, Adjonctions, Monades.

arxiv-2509-10823.title: From Paradigm Shift to Audit Rift: Empirical Analysis and Validation of Security Audit Methodologies for Asynchronous Smart Contract Systems
arxiv-2509-10823.creator: Yury Yanovich, Sergey Sobolev, Yash Madhwal, Kirill Ziborov, Vladimir Gorgadze, Victoria Kovalevskaya, Elizaveta Smirnova, Matvey Mishuris, Subodh Sharma
arxiv-2509-10823.description: Abstract The Open Network (TON) is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for scalability and efficiency, leveraging an asynchronous execution model and a multi-layered architecture. While TON’s design offers significant advantages, it also introduces unique challenges for smart contract development and security.

arxiv-2601-19171.title: Bridging Gulfs in UI Generation through Semantic Guidance Conference: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 13–17, 2026; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’26), April 13–17, 2026, Barcelona
arxiv-2601-19171.creator: Seokhyeon Park, Soohyun Lee, Eugene Choi, Hyunwoo Kim, Minkyu Kweon, Yumin Song, Jinwook Seo
arxiv-2601-19171.description: Abstract . While generative AI enables high-fidelity UI generation from text prompts, users struggle to articulate design intent and evaluate or refine results—creating gulfs of execution and evaluation. To understand the information needed for UI generation, we conducted a thematic analysis of UI prompting guidelines, identifying key design semantics and discovering that they are hierarchical and interdependent.

arxiv-2602-23353.title: SOTAlign: Semi-Supervised Alignment of Unimodal Vision and Language Models via Optimal Transport
arxiv-2602-23353.creator: Simon Roschmann, Paul Krzakala, Sonia Mazelet, Quentin Bouniot, Zeynep Akata
arxiv-2602-23353.description: Abstract The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that neural networks trained on different modalities converge toward a shared statistical model of the world. Recent work exploits this convergence by aligning frozen pretrained vision and language models with lightweight alignment layers, but typically relies on contrastive losses and millions of paired samples.

pmc-10611761.title: Associations of corticosteroid therapy and tonsillectomy with kidney survival in a multicenter prospective study for IgA nephropathy
pmc-10611761.creator: Tetsuya Kawamura, Keita Hirano, Kentaro Koike, Masako Nishikawa, Akira Shimizu, Kensuke Joh, Ritsuko Katafuchi, Akinori Hashiguchi, Keiichi Matsuzaki, Shoichi Maruyama, Nobuo Tsuboi, Ichiei Narita, Yuichiro Yano, Takashi Yokoo, Yusuke Suzuki
pmc-10611761.description: Efficacy of systemic corticosteroid therapy (CS) for long-term kidney survival in patients with IgA nephropathy (IgAN) is controversial. Therefore, prospective studies evaluating targeted therapies to lymphatic tissues in mucosal immune system responsible for production of nephritogenic IgA have been desired worldwide.

pmc-11513367.title: Editorial: Muscle oxygenation and vascular adaptations in sports performance and rehabilitation
pmc-11513367.creator: Rodrigo Yáñez-Sepúlveda, Daniel Rojas Valverde, Jose A. Parraca, François Billaut, Stéphane Perrey, Aldo A. Vasquez-Bonilla
pmc-11513367.description: logy, as applied to physical activity. The use of near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS, Perrey et al., 2024) to assess muscle oxygenation, alongside thermography to measure skin surface temperature (Tsk, Sillero-Quintana et al., 2021), has shown potential as tools for identifying physiological adaptations relevant to sport performance and health.

pmc-11667040.title: Effect of post heat treatment on microstructure and mechanical properties of hot-rolled AA2017 aluminum alloy
pmc-11667040.creator: Mauro Carta, Leila Aydi, Pasquale Buonadonna, Donato Morea, Mohamad El Mehtedi
pmc-11667040.description: This study investigates the effects of heat treatment, involving solubilization and aging, on the microstructure of AA2017-T451 aluminum alloy. Samples of 4 mm thick rolled plate of AA2017 underwent solution treatment at 500 °C for two different durations, namely 2 h and 6 h, followed by either water quenching (WQ) or air quenching (AQ).

pmc-12651572.title: A Bispecific Antibody Blocking Both TSLP and IL-4Rα for the Treatment of Allergic Inflammatory Diseases
pmc-12651572.creator: Mingcan Yu, Peng Chen, Ying Jin, Sheng Huang, Hao Jiang, Fulai Zhou, Mark L Chiu, Di Zhang, Mario Di Gioacchino

pmc-12838427.title: Minimum pulse rate during sleep as a MMSE-associated factor: a multifaceted exploratory study in older adults without long-term care certification
pmc-12838427.creator: Yuji Tanaka, Kozo Saito, Kyoichiro Tsuchiya, Yusuke Iwata, Takashi Ando, Kazuki Mochizuki, Tamami Taniguchi, Takahiko Mitsui
pmc-12838427.description: BackgroundDeveloping quantitative indicators of daily life that detect subtle cognitive decline is an important challenge in today's growing population of older adults worldwide. In this study, we aimed to explore novel candidates for indicators associated with subtle abnormalities in brief dementia screening test.

pmc-13206281.title: Chronic Pelvic Pain Attributable to Pelvic Congestion Syndrome: A Case Series
pmc-13206281.creator: Wen-Chi Wu, Lee-Wen Huang, Wen-Hsien Hsu, Ting-Chen Chang
pmc-13206281.description: BackgroundChronic pelvic pain (CPP) is a common, multifactorial condition that is often misdiagnosed. First described in ancient Egypt, CPP was linked in the 19th century to pelvic venous insufficiency, now known as pelvic congestion syndrome (PCS). PCS caused by congenital venous anomalies (primary) or secondary insufficiency and outflow obstruction is a specific, reversible, and underrecognized subset of CPP.

pmc-13506802.creator: Sajid Khan, Sabahat Jamil, Muhammad Hamza, Zarlish Attique, Suping Zhang
pmc-13506802.description: Metastatic breast cancer remains difficult to cure, and the way B and T lymphocytes adapt across metastatic niches especially under therapy remains insufficiently defined. pmc-13553718.creator: Katsunori Kouchi, Takashi Fumita, Chikako Nakata, Keita Kagaya
pmc-13553718.description: BackgroundNonoperative management (NOM) in blunt pancreatic injury (BPI) is frequently complicated by pseudocyst formation and pancreatic atrophy.
